messages:
maria_marketing: Heads up — planning an analyst & press briefing for the product launch. Proposed embargo: Tue 6pm PT. Need quote clearance + fact check window.

devon_pr: Confirming. Can we compress quote turnaround to Mon 9am PT so we have time to prep the embargo packet?

maria_marketing: Yes, Mon 9am is ideal. We should also lock attendee list by EOD Fri.

sam_product: Quick ask — will we provide a short technical appendix for analysts? I can drop a one-pager.

anya_research: Please include perf benchmark notes (latency/cost) and test config used. Analysts will want reproducibility.

maria_marketing: Agreed. Sam, can you add the appendix and a short note on benchmark configs. Anya, can you draft a concise methods blurb for fact-check?

sam_product: On it. Draft done by Thu.

anya_research: I'll draft the methods blurb by Thu afternoon.

maria_marketing: Devon — here's the proposed attendee CSV and who we want to prebrief. Can you reach out?

devon_pr: I can do outreach. Paste below the proposed list — please flag any no-gos.

maria_marketing: ```
Name,Organization,Role,Priority
Joan Lee,TechAnalyst,Senior Analyst,High
Ravi Patel,InfraWatch,Editor,High
Elena Gomez,AIWeekly,Reporter,Medium
Tom B.,FinTechInsights,Analyst,Low
```

devon_pr: Okay. I'll offer a 30-min prebrief window and an embargo-friendly summary. Also confirming: all embargo materials go to analysts under NDA?

maria_marketing: Yes — embargo materials + fact sheet under NDA. We'll send a one-page summary and the appendix + methods.

maria_marketing: Sample CEO quote we want cleared (please comment inline):

maria_marketing: ```
"We're excited to make inference predictable and economical at scale — giving engineering teams consistent performance across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
```

devon_pr: Sounds good. Kate, quick approval needed or edits?

kate_ceo: I prefer a bit shorter and stronger on customer impact. Suggest change to: 

kate_ceo: ```
"This launch makes high-performance inference predictable and cost-efficient for engineering teams building real products."
```

maria_marketing: Nice tweak. Devon — can you route Kate's final quote to legal for quick clearance?

devon_pr: Yup. Will loop in legal (legal_cc) and aim for sign-off by Mon 9am.

anya_research: One more ask — if legal requests any data points, please have Sam and I ready.

sam_product: I'll add the raw benchmark csv to the pack.

maria_marketing: Timeline recap:
- Thu: appendix + methods draft (Sam, Anya)
- Fri EOD: attendee list locked
- Mon 9am PT: final cleared quotes and embargo materials to be uploaded
- Tue 6pm PT: embargo lifts / press release out

devon_pr: Routing plan for inbound analyst questions during embargo window: direct to me via private thread; only devon_pr and maria_marketing respond. If technical deep-dive needed, escalate to sam_product.

maria_marketing: Agreed. Pressbot will post embargo reminder 24h and 2h before lift.

pressbot: [AUTO] Embargo reminder scheduled: 24h before 1769209856.

devon_pr: Last legal note — we need to avoid absolute performance claims. Any phrasing like "always" or "guaranteed" will get bounced. Stick to measured results.

maria_marketing: Noted. We'll use measured language and include benchmark caveats in the appendix.

kate_ceo: Approving the quote above. Thanks team.

maria_marketing: Thanks Kate. Devon — please confirm once legal clears and I'll assemble the embargo packet and upload to drive.

devon_pr: Will confirm. Target: Mon 8:30am PT confirmation so we have buffer.

maria_marketing: Perfect. Closing loop — everyone please bump any blockers into this thread. Thanks!
